note: M4A proposal. Not an approved configuration; it authorizes no training, pilot, data acquisition or test release. Every setting records its value, source, status and whether approval is required. See docs/V2_TRAINING_PROTOCOL.md.

status_vocabulary.INHERITED_V1: value used by the executed V1 confirmatory run (configs/experiments/v1_models.json)
status_vocabulary.INHERITED_V2_PROPOSAL: value from docs/V2_EXPERIMENTAL_PROTOCOL.md (research/v2-independent-validation, itself PROPOSED - REQUIRES APPROVAL)
status_vocabulary.NEWLY_PROPOSED_M4A: new in this milestone; rationale in docs/V2_TRAINING_PROTOCOL.md
status_vocabulary.CODE_INVARIANT: enforced by existing code; not a free choice

seeds.derivation: first 4 SHA-256 bytes of ASCII 'SolarJEPA-V2.1-paired-seed-i', big endian, mod 2**31, i=0.., skipping duplicates and 17/29/43 (independently recomputed in M4A)

jepa_objective.source: configs/experiments/v1_models.json; jepa_weight_during_finetune=0 is a ControlledConfig invariant

optimizer.source: configs/experiments/v1_models.json; reset is a training.controlled invariant

max_train_windows.policy: deterministic evenly spaced chronological subset of stride-1 complete training windows, identical for every neural/linear arm

supervised_warmup_epochs.rule: must equal ssl_epochs (check_paired_cohort enforces equal steps and replayed SSL order)

downstream_epochs.source: configs/experiments/v1_models.json (V1 maximum); fixed in V2 proposal

early_stopping.meaning: fixed schedule: all downstream epochs execute

alternative.tradeoff: saves compute but makes executed budgets arm-dependent and couples budget to validation noise

checkpoint_selection.source: docs/V2_EXPERIMENTAL_PROTOCOL.md section 5; eligibility and tie rule are training.controlled invariants

train_loss.rationale: aligns the optimized objective with the proposed equal-channel dex selection metric and primary estimand; whether it changes selected checkpoints is unmeasured

diagnostic_metrics.rationale: records V1-scale validation curves at no training effect, enabling the loss comparison

value.weight_decay_scope: all trainable parameters incl. biases (inherited V1 AdamW behaviour)

tcn.seed_rule: same paired seed as the J/S/B cohort, first 5 seeds

superseded_proposal.reason: penalty is lambda * mean(W^2) over 72,000 weights; the old grid is near-unregularized (docs/V2_BASELINE_AUDIT.md B1)

quantile_linear.boundary_rule: if validation selects the largest lambda, report BOUNDARY_SELECTED; in development only, one documented decade extension is allowed before the protocol is frozen; no extension after freeze

precision_and_device.rationale: 4 threads measured fastest on the M4 host (8 threads slower for every model); MPS/GPU not assumed

value.enforcement: StagedRun(max_rss_bytes=...) between jobs, one job per process recommended

per_job_timeout_seconds.rationale: about 5-8x the M4A extrapolated per-job time on the M4 host; a timeout is an infrastructure failure, not a model result

value.retry_identity: same seed, config and code fingerprints; logged in the run ledger
value.numerical_failure: recorded as model failure; no retry with changed settings; never drop or replace a seed

jepa_frozen.reuses: jepa_finetune SSL artifact of the same seed
